title: The friend's ♥A wins the trick; the declarer holds the joker and two trumps: throw the ♦Q
why: Last to play, the declarer sees the friend's ♥A winning, and nobody is left to overtake it. Of the joker, the ♦Q and the ♦4, the queen is right: it banks a point card on a trick the side wins anyway, while the joker and the small trump keep their use for the last two tricks. The joker onto a partner's sure trick is the misplay the 2026-10-04 audit flagged most often. Found by the miner in hand 29 of `hard` bots (default), seat 1.

title: Two tricks left under 기본, the joker and the ♦K, with the ♦A still out: play the king
why: The joker-before-the-last-trick rule has an exception. Here the ♦K overtakes the ♦Q now and banks the point cards in the trick, and the joker, powerless on the last trick, loses nothing that was not lost anyway. Playing the joker now instead leaves the king for the last trick, where the ♦A, still out, takes it. Guards against over-applying the fix.
